summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of LiveChat app. 32/32 backend pytest tests passed covering auth, chat sessions, websocket bidirectional messaging (agent<->customer), file upload/download (agent & customer), disallowed extension rejection, message edit/delete permissions, AI suggest/summarize (LLM works), quick replies CRUD, agents CRUD + admin RBAC, admin metrics, settings, public settings, CSAT. Frontend Playwright covered: wrong-password error, agent login->/dashboard with status toggle+sound+menu, agent status change, logout->/login, admin login->/admin with metrics chart, add-agent dialog succeeds and appears in list, branding tab loads, widget-demo full flow: launcher opens, prechat submits, message sent via WebSocket (Sent indicator confirmed), file attach uploads image and previews via /api/files/{id}.

ui_bugs.issue: Text renders literally as 'We're online' instead of 'We’re online' (HTML entity in JSX string not decoded). Location: /app/frontend/src/components/ChatWidget.jsx line 270.

Chat launcher button can be intercepted by the Emergent badge overlay at bottom-right (same position, z-index conflict) when hover/click via real user. Consider offsetting launcher position (e.g., bottom-24 or right-24) to avoid overlap.

issues: React accessibility warning: DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby (both Add Agent + Edit Message dialogs). Add <DialogDescription> for a11y.
Recharts logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warning briefly during initial mount; disappears once container has size but suggests missing min-height on the flex parent during first paint.

action_items: Replace the literal ''' in ChatWidget header with a proper apostrophe (use {"We're online"} or a plain '’').

Move floating chat launcher off the Emergent badge's overlap zone (e.g., bottom-24 right-6) or increase z-index and add pointer-events handling; real users will find the badge blocks the launcher in preview.
Add <DialogDescription> to Dialogs to silence a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1074 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, chat, ws, admin, storage) as it grows.

CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for cookie auth in strict mode; login flow currently works because frontend uses localStorage Bearer, but the httpOnly cookie set at login is effectively unusable cross-origin. Either restrict origins or drop cookie.
broadcast_to_session sends to ALL connected agents unconditionally — potential noise/privacy issue in multi-tenant contexts. OK for MVP.
put_object/get_object are sync requests inside async endpoints; will block event loop for large uploads. Consider run_in_executor or httpx.AsyncClient.
ai_suggest/ai_summarize return empty string/list on LLM failure which is correct (no 500); however when LLM library is missing the errors log every call — fine for now.
Password field on CreateAgentBody has no min length validation.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed sessions, agents, quick-replies which may remain in DB (soft residue only, no interference).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. WebSocket flow verified with real python-websockets client. If retesting frontend widget launcher, use JS-click to bypass the Emergent badge overlay: page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"chat-launcher\"]').click()"). Customer session persists in localStorage under key 'customer_session' — clear before each fresh prechat test.
